caption: The drawing features two main objects on a plain light background. At the top is a greenish-brown ceramic jug or vessel with a single arching handle extending from one side of its opening to the other. The body of the jug is decorated with yellow and brown swirling patterns, and a rectangular panel on the front contains the inscription "B R 1792." Below the jug is a brownish-red line drawing depicting a symmetrical, stylized floral or ornamental design with three central flower-like shapes, each with decorative loops, swirls, and dot accents, giving the appearance of a folk-art motif. The artist’s signature, "Frances Lichten," is present to the right of the jug.
title: Pa. German Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
